title: AssetIngestRequested
description: Somebody put a file in somewhere else and wants it read. The bytes are already in the store; only the two ids travel. Keys are snake_case, not the camelCase the rest of leaf uses: this travels inside a Liquid envelope, whose own fields (event_id, occurred_at, event_type, owner_unit_ref) are snake_case and pinned byte-exact by signed golden vectors. The shape follows the wire.

asset_id.description: The asset to read, in the system that holds it.

job_id.description: The job to report the reading against. Written by whoever asked, so the asker can follow the work without waiting for a reply.
